Thanks Mark — received the schematic and the three requests. Quick notes up front:

- We can map the control-plane egress requirements to three logical categories (telemetry, cert/KMS, billing/usage) and provide a minimal egress ACL set for each.
- For the data-plane split, our recommended pattern is a split-plane with a thin control proxy in the customer tenant VPC and a managed data-plane exit via a tenant-dedicated NAT/egress path. That lets you keep KV caches per-tenant while routing burst traffic through a shared inference pool with tenant QoS.

Proposed next actions:
- Thursday 10:00–10:45 PT for a technical review + runbook draft (Irene / Kimberly to join).
- We'll prepare an ops-checklist and a short evidence package for SOC2 (logs mapping + KMS integration summary) before the sync.

A couple of clarifying Qs before the call:
1) Do you plan to run the KMS on-prem (HSM) or leverage cloud KMS?
2) Any hard egress constraints (e.g., no outbound to public IPs except to specific endpoints)?

If you confirm the meeting slot I'll send a calendar invite.

Hi Mark / team — attaching the ops checklist (ops-checklist.xlsx) and a short excerpt from the runbook below. This is the minimal staging acceptance we recommend prior to cutover.

Runbook excerpt (staging acceptance):
- Validate control plane outbound rules: allow TCP to telemetry.redwood.net:443, kms.redwood.net:443, billing.redwood.net:443 only. Capture egress flow logs (10 minutes sample).
- Confirm KMS reachability and test key unwrap from tenant VMs. Record KMS logs and verify access control entries.
- KV cache sanity: run 10-minute load test per tenant, verify cache TTL/eviction behaves under QoS policy.
- Canary traffic: route 5% of inference requests from a single tenant through the new split-plane path and monitor latency + error budget for 30 minutes.
- Observability: ensure token-level tracing and per-tenant cost counters are present in the sample traces.

Attachments: ops-checklist.xlsx (Excel, 45KB)

Related links: https://drive.redwood.company/drive/folders/novacore-vpc-review-7782 (runbook + diagrams)

Let me know if Novacore needs these formatted as evidence bundles for audit. We can produce a zip with logs, config snapshots, and the KMS access mapping.
